# Dot import flattens a package's exported declarations into the importing
# scope, so they are referenced unqualified. Needs the real CLI: directory
# import resolution is not available to the checker's own testdata harness.
sngl check main.sngl
stdout 'main.sngl: ok'

# Without the dot the same names are only reachable qualified.
! sngl check plain.sngl
stderr 'unknown type "Card"'

# Unexported (underscore-prefixed) declarations are not lifted.
! sngl check unexported.sngl
stderr 'undefined: _helper'

# A user declaration shadows a dot-imported one of the same name: imports are
# processed first, so the later user declaration wins in the same scope.
sngl generate --out out shadow.sngl
grep 'MINE' out/index.html
! grep 'hello ' out/index.html

# The dot form flattens the standard library into the file.
sngl check std.sngl
stdout 'std.sngl: ok'

# The namespace form binds the stdlib under an alias. Both forms are valid —
# the scheme means neither can collide with a local package directory.
sngl check stdbare.sngl
stdout 'stdbare.sngl: ok'

# The alias is the caller's choice, and it is what qualifies the stdlib.
sngl check stdalias.sngl
stdout 'stdalias.sngl: ok'

# Without the import there is no such namespace: `sngl` is no longer an
# implicit global.
! sngl check stdunimported.sngl
stderr 'undefined: sngl'

# Two dot imports lifting the same name is an error. Taking the last silently
# would make which package a bare name refers to depend on import order.
! sngl check ambiguous.sngl
stderr 'already lifted by dot import of'

# Qualifying one of them resolves it.
sngl check disambiguated.sngl
stdout 'disambiguated.sngl: ok'

# A local directory named std is reachable as itself; the stdlib scheme cannot
# shadow it.
sngl check localstd.sngl
stdout 'localstd.sngl: ok'

# An extension against a namespace that is not an imported library package is
# an error, not a skip. Silently ignoring it would drop every override the file
# declares and still produce a successful build with unstyled output.
! sngl check badext.sngl
stderr 'extension namespace "notstd" is not an imported library package'

# Any library package can be overridden, not just std: a program needs to draw
# draw.canvas as much as std.vbox. A program declares one the same way a
# platform package does, by naming the target on the declaration.
sngl check extdraw.sngl
stdout 'extdraw.sngl: ok'

# Naming another package's declaration without saying which target it
# implements is not a declaration of anything.
! sngl check extdraw_untargeted.sngl
stderr 'must name the target it implements'

# Only sngl:ui exists so far.
! sngl check stdunknown.sngl
stderr 'unknown stdlib package "widgets"'

-- widgets/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Card {
    title string = ""
}

func Greet(who string) => "hello " + who

func _helper() => "internal"

window {
}
-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "widgets"

component main node {
    var c Card = {title = "t"}
    var g = Greet("world")
    text(value=c.title + g)
}

window {
    main
}
-- plain.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "widgets"

component main node {
    var c Card = {title = "t"}
    text(value=c.title)
}

window {
    main
}
-- unexported.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "widgets"

component main node {
    var h = _helper()
    text(value=h)
}

window {
    main
}
-- shadow.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { none { html } }

import . "widgets"

func Greet(who string) => "MINE " + who

window #w(href="/index.html") {
    text(value=Greet("x"))
}
-- std.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    text(value="x")
}

window {
    main
}
-- stdbare.sngl --
import "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    ui.text(value="x")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- stdalias.sngl --
import lib "sngl:ui"

component text() lib.node {}

component main lib.node {
    lib.text(value="stdlib, not the shadow")
    text()
}

lib.window {
    main
}
-- stdunimported.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    sngl.text(value="x")
}

window {
    main
}
-- localstd.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "std"

component main node {
    text(value=std.greet())
}

window {
    main
}
-- std/helper.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func greet() => "local package named std"

window {
}
-- badext.sngl --
import sngl "sngl:ui"

component notstd.text {
    span(textContent=value) {}
}

component main sngl.node {
    text(value="x")
}

sngl.window {
    main
}
-- other/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Card {
    subtitle string = ""
}

window {
}
-- ambiguous.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "widgets"
import . "other"

component main node {
    var c Card = {title = "t"}
    text(value=c.title)
}

window {
    main
}
-- disambiguated.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "widgets"
import o "other"

component main node {
    var c Card = {title = "t"}
    var d o.Card = {subtitle = "s"}
    text(value=c.title + d.subtitle)
}

window {
    main
}
-- stdunknown.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:widgets"

component main node {
    text(value="x")
}

window {
    main
}
-- extdraw.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"
import d "sngl:ui/draw"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component d.canvas[html.platform] {
    s.text(value="styled")
}

s.window {
}
-- extdraw_untargeted.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"
import d "sngl:ui/draw"

component d.canvas {
    s.text(value="styled")
}

s.window {
}
